items.title: US Prosecutors Want $84.2 Million From a Bank Tied to Tether
items.summary: Federal prosecutors are targeting a Montana payments firm and a Caribbean bank accused of moving money without a license.

items.title: Another appeals court rules against prediction market provider Kalshi, says sports contracts are subject to state regulations
items.summary: A Sixth Circuit Court of Appeals panel ruled that prediction markets' sports-related events contracts are not swaps, and therefore aren't subject to federal regulatory oversight.

items.title: EBA Floats Stablecoin Lending Restrictions for EU Crypto Firms
items.summary: The regulator wants the EU to examine rules for DeFi gateways, with leverage caps and certification of lending protocols among the options.

items.title: OG.com seeks CFTC approval for single-stock perpetual futures
items.summary: OG.com, recently spun out of Crypto.com, joins Coinbase, Kalshi and Kraken parent Payward in seeking approval to bring perpetual futures to individual US stocks.
